_doc: Backtest cases — real, cited disruptions used to grade TRINETRA's approach against what actually happened. Every fact carries a source. 'claim' is what TRINETRA asserts it would surface; 'caveat' states honestly what it does NOT claim. Misses are shown, not hidden.

cases.name: Red Sea / Houthi crisis

signal.event: First major Houthi attack — seizure of the Galaxy Leader

market_reaction.what: Maersk, Hapag-Lloyd and others suspended Red Sea transit and diverted around the Cape of Good Hope from mid-December 2023 (+10–16 days per voyage); Bab el-Mandeb oil transit fell 8.7 → 4.0 mb/d.

cases.claim: A Bab el-Mandeb shock trigger on the November advisory would have surfaced Cape rerouting — the exact move shippers executed weeks later — and flagged the added transit days against days-of-cover.
cases.caveat: Crude price impact was muted; freight and insurance moved more. We claim reroute-option recall and detection lead, NOT a crude-price forecast.

cases.name: Abqaiq–Khurais attack

signal.event: Drone/missile strike knocks out 5.7 mb/d (~5% of world supply)

market_reaction.what: Brent posted its largest single-day gain in a decade; Aramco drew on inventories and restored output in ~2 weeks, and prices fell back below pre-attack levels.

cases.claim: A 5.7 mb/d supply shock would immediately rank an SPR draw and alternative sourcing; the zero-LLM critic keeps sanctioned substitutes out of the plan.
cases.caveat: This was a single facility outage, not a chokepoint closure; recovery was fast. We do not claim we'd predict the 2-week restoration.

cases.name: Strait of Hormuz closure

signal.event: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iran begin; IRGC VHF 'no transit' warnings

market_reaction.what: Iran declared the Strait closed on 4 Mar 2026; ~150 tankers anchored; crude rose >50% during the conflict; a US–Iran de-escalation began reopening it mid-June 2026.
market_reaction.source_org: Al Jazeera / Britannica / UK HoC Library CBP-10636

cases.claim: This is the live case TRINETRA replays: the Feb-28 advisory fires the shock; the plan surfaces reroutes, SPR draw and demand cuts before the 4-Mar closure and the price spike.
cases.caveat: A documented real event (not a forecast). Per-refinery inventories and spot availability in the replay are modeled (prov S), not confidential real data.
